headline: A 1-for-3 night
record_line: Yesterday: 1-2 on the top plays · Season: 57-233

entries.headline: Ben Rice connected at +361
entries.story: Ben Rice cashed. Facing Freddy Peralta, he went deep in the 4th in his 2nd at bat. The call: "Ben Rice homers (3) on a fly ball to right field." He added another later in the game. Final line: 2-for-3 with 1 BB.

entries.headline: Junior Caminero came close
entries.story: Junior Caminero went 2-for-4 against Cam Schlittler and the New York Yankees. Closest call was a double in the 5th: "Junior Caminero doubles (1) on a sharp line drive to center fielder Trent Grisham. Jonathan Aranda to 3rd." The power showed up; the carry did not.

entries.headline: Munetaka Murakami stayed in the yard
entries.story: Munetaka Murakami went 1-for-4 with 1 RBI against Gavin Williams and the Cleveland Guardians. No real scare on the HR front.
